decisions.vdd_cpu_buck: CHOSEN: Silergy SYR837PKC (C178248), with Rockchip RK860-0 (C19188628) as a pin/address/register-identical second source. Facts (AN_SYR837/SYR838 Rev0.9A): 7-bit I2C address 0x40 (SYR838 = 0x41); VSEL0/VSEL1 reset value NSEL=010111 = 1.000 V (range 0.7125-1.5 V, 12.5 mV/step) -> safe RK3566 VDD_CPU boot voltage; 6 A continuous; PMOS peak limit 7.5 A, NMOS valley 6 A; VIN 2.6-5.5 V, UVLO 2.45-2.55 V, input OVP 6.15 V; 2.4 MHz; soft-start 300 us; package CSP1.56x1.96-20 0.4 mm pitch; pinout A1 VSEL, A2 EN (do not float), A3 SCL, A4 VOUT sense, B1 SDA, B4 AGND, B2/B3/C1-C4 GND, D1/D2/E1/E2 VIN, D3/D4/E3/E4 SW - identical to the SOQuartz TCS4525 footprint (U3) so the SOQuartz sheet-20 circuit is kept (EN 51K pull-up to VCC3V3_PMU, VSEL from PMIC_SLEEP_H via 22R, SDA/SCL via 22R from I2C0, VOUT sense via 100R). Recommended L 0.25 uH, CIN >=22 uF, COUT 22 uF+ (RK860 datasheet: L 0.22-0.47 uH, CIN >10 uF (2x10 uF), COUT 44-88 uF). Board values: L = TDK TFM252012ALMAR22MTAA 0.22 uH (Isat 8.0 A, 13 mOhm max); CIN = 1x 22uF 25V 0805 (C45783) + 1x 10uF 25V 0603 (C96446) + 100nF; COUT = 2x 22uF 6.3V 0603 (C59461) + 100nF 0201 at the buck, remaining bulk under the SoC. VIN from the 5 V CM4 input (VCC5V0_SYS), as in SOQuartz; 5.25 V max is within 5.5 V. Linux: mainline drivers/regulator/fan53555.c - SYR837 = compatible 'silergy,syr827' (ID1 die=8 -> SILERGY_SYR82X, vsel_min 712500 uV, step 12500 uV); RK860-0 = compatible 'rockchip,rk8600' (RK8600_CHIP_ID_08, same range). Use fcs,suspend-voltage-selector = <1> as on SOQuartz-style designs. REJECTED: RK860-2 (C5156489) and RK860-3 (C5156487): RK860 datasheet Rev1.6 chapter 3 gives I2C 0x42/0x43, default Vout 0.8 V, 0.5-1.5 V @6.25 mV, DIE_ID 0xA (VSEL0_B/VSEL1_B registers 0x06/0x07 reset 0x30 = 0.8 V) - 0.8 V at power-on is below the RK3566 VDD_CPU boot requirement; they are RK3588 big-core parts (driver 'rockchip,rk8602'). SYR837 chosen over RK860-0 because it is half the price ($0.45 vs $0.92) with ~3.6x the stock (1032 vs 286); RK860-0 is rated Tj -40..125 C vs SYR837 Ta -40..85 C, so pick RK860-0 if extended temperature matters.
decisions.emmc: CHOSEN: KIOXIA THGBMUG6C1LBAIL (C7509349) 8 GB eMMC 5.1, 153-ball 11.5x13x0.8 mm, stock 339, $31.98 (cheapest stocked 8/16 GB FBGA153). KIOXIA product brief: VCC 2.7-3.6 V, VCCQ 1.70-1.95 V or 2.7-3.6 V, HS400 400 MB/s, -25..85 C. Alternate: Samsung KLMAG1JETD-B041 16 GB (C499919, stock 332, $35.52); its datasheet confirms VDD(VCCQ) 1.70-1.95 V or 2.7-3.6 V, VDDF(VCC) 2.7-3.6 V, VDDi = internal core-regulator node needing CReg. Others checked: KLM8G1GETF-B041 (C499918, st 67, $33.48), MKEV008GCB-SC510 (C2987689, st 355, $40.10), SDINBDG4-8G-XI1 (C577445, $66.81), FORESEE FEMDME008G-A8A39 (C3249972, st 120, $46.25). Power per SOQuartz sheets 21/23: VCC = VCC3V3_FLASH (VCC_3V3 via 0R 0402), VCCQ = VCCIO_FLASH = VCC_1V8 via 0R 0402, FLASH_VOL_SEL (RK3566 GPIO0_A7) pulled up 10K to VCC3V3_PMU so VCCIO2 runs 1.8 V I/O. Decoupling (SOQuartz): VCCQ 3x100nF 0201 + 4.7uF 0402; VCC 2x100nF + 4.7uF 0402; VDDi cap (SOQuartz text shows 4.7uF 0402 6.3V near VDDi/C2, ambiguous) - neither retrieved datasheet gives the CReg value in extractable text; JEDEC-typical is ~0.1-2.2 uF, so 1 uF (C52923) or 2.2 uF (C12530) is the safe choice - UNRESOLVED, check the vendor full datasheet. Pull-ups 10K on CMD, D0, RST_n; data-strobe 47K pull-down DNP.

decisions.inductors: RK809 BUCK1-5: 5x INPAQ WIP252012P-R47ML (C964119) 0.47 uH 2520x1.2, DCR 21/25 mOhm, Isat 5.3/4.95 A, Irms 4.6/4.18 A (meets SOQuartz 'DCR<50mohm, 2.5A' notes). VDD_CPU: TDK TFM252012ALMAR22MTAA (C404798) 0.22 uH, Isat 8.0 A min/9.0 typ (-30% L), Itemp 6.7 A, DCR 13 mOhm max - SOQuartz used 0.24 uH IND_252010. SY8113B: XRIM404020S2R2MGCA (C39846857) 2.2 uH 4x4x2, DCR 30/36 mOhm, Irms 5.0 A, Isat 8.5 A min. SY8113B datasheet sizing (40% ripple, fsw 500 kHz) gives 1.9-2.0 uH for 5 V->3.3 V/3 A, so 2.2 uH rather than 1-1.5 uH (1.5 uH would give ~1.5 A ripple, Ipk ~3.75 A - also workable, but DCR<50 mOhm & Isat>Ipk are the datasheet criteria). Rejected YNR4030-2R2M (C340389): Irms 2.95 A < 3 A load.
decisions.sy8113b: VFB = 0.6 V (+/-1.5%, 0.591-0.609 V); Vout = 0.6*(1+R1/R2); datasheet example R1=100k, R2=22.1k for 3.3 V. Chosen R1=100k 1% (C25741, basic), R2=22k 1% (C25768, basic) -> 3.327 V nominal. SOQuartz used 232K/49.9K (3.39 V 'Default'). Optional 22 pF C0G across R1 (C1555) per datasheet load-transient note. CIN 10 uF 25V 0603 (C96446) + 100nF; COUT 2x 22 uF 0603 (datasheet >22 uF) + 100nF; BS 100 nF (C307331). EN: 100K pull-up to VIN (SOQuartz R51) or drive from CM4 GLOBAL_EN logic. CAUTION: UVLO 4.5 V rising / 4.2 V falling and the 3.3 V output at Vin 4.75 V needs ~72% duty with 140-220 ns min off-time - OK at 500 kHz, but input droop below ~4.2 V shuts it off.
decisions.ddr_calibration: From SOQuartz: RK3566 DDR_RZQ = 120R 1% (sheet 9, R1, 0201) - NOT 240R. LPDDR4 ZQ0/ZQ1 = 240R 1% 0201 (sheet 22, R60/R61) as required by JEDEC LPDDR4 (240R 1% to VDDQ). 120R 1%: C473017 (0201, stock 45267) or C25079 (0402 basic). 240R 1%: no 0201/0402 1% part with jlcsearch-confirmed stock >=500 - C25094 (0402WGF2400TCE) / C155745 (RC0201FR-07240RL) listed with stock unverified - UNRESOLVED.
decisions.rk809_support_parts: From SOQuartz sheet 19/10: VCC_DDR (BUCK3) FB divider 47K 1% top / 120K 1% bottom (FB3=0.8 V -> 1.113 V for LPDDR4); BUCK1/2/4 and VDD_CPU remote-sense 100R from SoC; BATDIV 20K 1%; RESETn 10K pull-up to VCC3V3_PMU with 100nF; PWRON 20K + 10nF/100nF RC; I2C0 pull-ups 2.2K to VCC3V3_PMU; 32K out series 22R; FB1 120R@100MHz 2A ferrite (C141722); RK809 LDO outputs 1uF 0201 X5R; buck outputs 22uF 0603 + 10uF 0402 + 100nF; VREF 1uF; VCC_RTC 1uF. No separate reset supervisor is needed - RK809 RESETB drives RESETn/nPOR.
decisions.connector_warning: C597931 = DF40C-100DS-0.4V(51) is the receptacle that goes on the CARRIER (CM4 datasheet 3.1: 'mating connector DF40C-100DS-0.4v' / DF40HC(3.0)-100DS-0.4v). A CM4-form-factor module must use the plug DF40C-100DP-0.4V(51) (as SOQuartz sheet 18 does: DF40C-100DP-0D4V). jlcsearch did not return an LCSC number for DF40C-100DP-0.4V(51) - UNRESOLVED; confirm on LCSC before ordering.
decisions.stock_caveat: jlcsearch returns stock = null for JLCPCB basic-library parts and for many extended passives (and also for every part when queried by C-number). Stock figures in this file come from text/category searches; null means 'not reported', not 'zero'. Basic parts are normally in the millions; extended parts flagged 'VERIFY' must be checked. JLCPCB has no basic 0201 parts in jlcsearch's data, so all 0201 passives are extended (selected with stock >=500 where data existed).
